AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
Pocket Casts is a podcast player. Its functions search episodes of the podcasts the user follows, play an episode, add an episode to the Up Next queue, bookmark the current playback position, and set a sleep timer.
Operational patterns: - Call 'searchEpisodes' to get the episodeUuid for 'playEpisode' and 'addToUpNext'. For requests such as 'the latest episode of a podcast', pass only podcastTitle and use the first result. - Use 'addToUpNext' when the user wants to keep listening to the current episode, and 'playEpisode' when they want to listen now. - 'addBookmark' and 'setSleepTimer' act on the current playback and take no episodeUuid.
Constraints: - Search covers only podcasts the user follows, not the full podcast catalog. - Bookmarks require a Pocket Casts Plus or Patron subscription.
